description: Hospital Inpatient Occupancy is published by Open Data Nova Scotia. The table reports inpatient occupancy measures by hospital, service type and date. Its stated coverage is Nova Scotia, Canada; hospitals in Nova Scotia Health and IWK. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Nova Scotia Open Government Licence. Calculated occupancy depends on the specified bed denominator and service category. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
